agent-manifest.description: Deterministic registry of the Knights of the Round Table: enrollment (name + professed quest), each knight's favourite colour and shrubbery budget, the active verified knight for the session, and which trials each has passed. Isolated per knight.

offer.body: Confirms whether a seeker matches an enrolled Knight of the Round Table (by name and professed quest); the verdict the Marshal uses to settle verification.
The verified knight's record for this session (name, favourite colour, shrubbery budget). Consumed by every agent that must act for the right knight.
Which trials the knight has passed (bridge, ni), so the Marshal can report progress and gate the Grail on both.
Records a trial as passed, keyed to the verified knight; the trials call this only after their own gate has held.
Each knight's identity and trial progress are keyed to that knight and never readable or writable across knights (services/registry.py).

use.body: Accepts the verified-knight assertion from the Marshal; state is updated only for the identity it verified this turn.
